Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.smoother

Interface FloatTransitionSmoother

All Superinterfaces:
TransitionSmoother
All Known Implementing Classes:
AcceleratingFloatSmoother, LinearFloatSmoother, NaturalFloatSmoother, OscillatingFloatSmoother, SpringFloatSmoother
public interface FloatTransitionSmoother extends TransitionSmoother
Interface for utility classes that generates sequence of float values. Typically it keeps an internal value and changes it towards a given target value gradually.
